# logic2b UI rules

## Stack and theme

- Target: React 19 + Tailwind CSS v4. Verify the existing project's versions and aliases before changing code.
- Icons: lucide-react. Use the project's configured imports and stylesheet entry.
- Use semantic tokens (bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, border-border); preserve deliberate token overrides. Check light and dark modes.
- Read DESIGN.md for the preset reference; actual CSS and project instructions remain authoritative.

## Work within the project

- Prefer installed primitives and registry blocks. Respect intentional native HTML, custom wrappers, existing libraries and project policies.
- Inspect behavior contracts and connect real data and callbacks. Test applicable loading, empty/no-results, error/retry, validation, submitting, permission and unsaved-change states.
- Give controls accessible names; verify keyboard operation and mobile layout. Disabled controls do not enforce server permissions.
- Preserve custom copy, columns and styles. Do not manually edit .logic2b/ snapshots or manifests; the installer manages them for safe updates.
- Follow existing user authorization. Do not request redundant approval for an already authorized change.
- Only call tools available in this host. If review_ui or logic2b review is available, review the changed TSX/JSX sources; enable semanticColors only for an explicit policy and keep unresolved label context partial. Read unknowns and truncation, not just findings. Use the project's type checks and runtime/browser checks. compose_plan and proposal links remain planned; report what could not be verified.

## Installed inventory

Components: button.
Blocks: customers.
Charts: chart-area.
Other: none.

## Install and inspect

- With a shell: npx logic2b@next inspect --details full; npx logic2b@next add <name>. Reconcile detected aliases and preserve local edits.
- Without a shell: inspect_project accepts a host-supplied snapshot; install_plan returns files and npm dependencies, and scaffold_plan creates a new project. The host applies plans within its authorized scope.
- MCP: https://ui.logic2b.com/mcp or npx -y @logic2b/mcp@next. Check the running tool catalog.
- Registry discovery: https://ui.logic2b.com/llms.txt · https://ui.logic2b.com/docs/llms
- No preset was supplied; inspect the project's CSS before inferring token values.
<!-- logic2b:rules:end -->

# Design reference

No preset was supplied. Read the project's configured stylesheet for actual tokens, typography, radius and light/dark overrides. Do not replace them with assumed defaults.
